lines.text: How does my toilet know when to STOP filling?
It doesn't know anything. It's a toilet.
A ball? Like a pool toy?
Basically. It floats on the water, on the end of an arm.
You flush, the water drops, and the ball drops with it.
The arm tips down and opens a little valve. Water rushes in.
And the ball rides the water back up!
Yep. Higher water, higher ball. The arm lifts... and pushes the valve shut.
Water stops at the exact same line. Every single time.
So my toilet is smarter than my smart fridge.
Your fridge has an app. Your toilet has a ball.
Then why does mine keep running at night?
Ball set too high, or a worn valve. The extra water sneaks down the overflow pipe.
